1. `/employee-experience`
2. `/voice-ai-employee`
3. `/finops`
4. `/trust-and-security`

## Rule

- Ema-owned links must stay local.
- If a page is not yet replicated, route to a local placeholder instead of sending users to the original website.
- Prefer depth on core product pages over breadth across low-value company/resource pages.
